prompts.face_front: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: frontal Tripo Smart Mesh reconstruction reference, single view. Input image 1 is the authoritative character identity and style reference. Create a high quality clean 3D-rendered front view of EXACTLY this same charming stylized young female game character's head, ears, neck and upper shoulders down to the clavicles. Preserve her distinctive soft round facial proportions, warm peach skin with subtle blush, small elegant nose, gentle almond-shaped open brown eyes, upper lids covering a little of the irises, naturally shaped eyebrows, and gentle friendly expression. Change only two things from the reference: remove all scalp hair to show a clean bald skull with the ears visible; open her mouth enough for 3D mouth interior reconstruction. The mouth is moderately open vertically, relaxed and gently smiling, NOT shouting, not puckered, not a giant grin: clear separated upper and lower lips, visible upper tooth row and lower tooth edges, small pink tongue, dark recessed oral cavity behind them. Mouth opening about one third of the mouth width. Build clearly visible continuous upper and lower eyelids as part of the facial skin, slim dark upper lash fringe rooted directly along the upper lid edge, sparse subtle lower lashes rooted directly along the lower lid edge; no floating strips or giant lashes. Eyebrows remain visible. No painted fake tears, eyeliner wings, dangling hair, separate parts, wires, cross sections, or facial expression sheet. Perfectly straight front camera, no head tilt, both ears visible equally. Head-neck-clavicle bust only, no clothing, no chest below the collarbones, centered and filling most of a square image with a little margin around the skull and shoulders. Uniform pale gray background, soft neutral even studio illumination, no sharp cast shadows, no text, no watermark. Faithful to the user's reference, NOT the wide-eyed v3 Blender face.

Neutral uniform pale-gray background, even soft diffuse lighting, no dramatic reflections. NO contact sheet, NO view labels, NO text, NO transparent checkerboard, NO accessory. This is the sculptural shape reference; do not draw rectangular hair cards or wireframe overlays.
